candidate.definition_en: A person who is sexually attracted to people of their own sex.
candidate.explanation_ar: الشخص المثلي جنسياً؛ وهو من ينجذب عاطفياً وجنسياً لأشخاص من نفس جنسه.

senses.definition_en: A person who is sexually attracted to people of their own sex.
senses.definition_ar: شخص ينجذب عاطفياً وجنسياً لأشخاص من نفس جنسه.

examples: He lived openly as a homosexual at a time when society was deeply intolerant.
The activist was recognized as a prominent homosexual who fought bravely for civil rights.
The new legislation ensured that no homosexual could be denied housing based on sexual orientation.
candidate.mnemonic: البادئة 'homo-' في اليونانية تعني 'نفس' (same)، و'sexual' تعني جنسي، فالمعنى شخص ينجذب جنسياً لمن هو من نفس جنسه.
